title: E-FRC-0097: over several beats the committed rule does produce three-tone joint effects, but only around a tone pair...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0097 in the gauge arena: over several beats the committed rule does produce three-tone joint effects, but only around a tone pair that already interacts, and never with the third tone that closes a zero-sum triangle, so the multi-beat coupling is generic re-scattering and not a triangle (A2) vertex.
known_limitations: Depth L3 (L3: one base rule produced the result as a measured consequence, with a computed control that could have failed).
